title: Fit-only threshold transport on TweetEval/hate
question: M1.38 的 target_prior rescue 使用 test 分数分位点（transductive）；把阈值换成 fit 内 OOF 分位点后，candidate gain 和绝对 accuracy 是否还在？

dataset.name: TweetEval/hate
dataset.note: same corpus as M1.15/M1.38; no new corpus.

modeling.c_selection: f32 only, 5-fold StratifiedKFold on fit, accuracy; f32 and quantized arm share C

global_fit_prior.note: deployable control; OOF folds are the same 5 folds used for C selection

H1_threshold_transport.statement: On f32, global_fit_prior overall accuracy is close to global_test_prior; a large negative gap means the M1.38 rescue depends on test score distribution.

H2_candidate_transport.statement: Under global_fit_prior, the quantized arm minus f32 remains positive for the M1.38 candidate cells (L12 R12, L6 rescan), i.e. the gain is deployable without test scores.

H3_absolute_calibration.statement: global_fit_prior does not collapse absolute accuracy relative to default; report the gap descriptively.

primary_endpoint.units: depth x probe x seed; 2 depths x 2 probes x 5 seeds = 20 cells

verdict.retained: for each depth/probe family, >=4/5 positive CIs and 5-seed mean > 0
verdict.partially_retained: one probe family meets retained, the other has >=2/5 positive CIs
verdict.not_retained: both probe families have <=1/5 positive CIs

primary_endpoint.note: This is a transport test, not a new candidate confirmation; the same TweetEval test is reused.

secondary_endpoints: global_fit_prior - global_test_prior on f32 overall accuracy
global_fit_prior - default and global_test_prior - default on f32 overall accuracy
predicted positive rate and threshold by rule
candidate arm - f32 under default and global_test_prior, for direct comparison to M1.38

independence_and_boundaries.seeds: 5 seeds share the same test texts and often the same C; not independent repeats.
independence_and_boundaries.corpus: single TweetEval/hate test, n=2,734; this does not add cross-corpus evidence.

m1_38_reference.note: M1.38 full-test target_prior 5-seed means; reference only, not a paired comparison.

independence_and_boundaries.candidate: M1.38/M1.39/M1.40 already rejected or left inconclusive; M1.42 asks whether the threshold is deployable, not whether the candidate is confirmed.

prereg_commit_policy: Committed before running model-score or accuracy computation.
